About the Role: Are you a passionate programmer who loves coding and computer games? Would you like to help children create their first projects and take their first steps into the programming world by teaching them Python? If so, this opportunity is perfect for you! Responsibilities: Deliver fun and interactive Python Programming lessons using provided materials. Develop your own skills under the guidance of experienced Kodland teachers. Share feedback about lessons with the Kodland team. Regularly report on student progress and help improve the learning experience.
